thesis: AMPH has run +37% in 63 days and is trading well above the 24.5 mean analyst target, with the post-earnings spike to 31.0 rejected the same day (close 28.49). Reward/risk is only about 1.15 to the nearest resistance, which is thin for a stock that needs to hold up in a risk-off tape (QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX 1-year percentile 0.877, TNX 5.141). Short interest of 21.7% of float brings volatile two-way moves, and debt of 692M against cash of 231M leaves the balance sheet exposed to rates. The earnings catalyst is already spent, with no scheduled catalyst in the next 20 business days, so this is a chase of an extended name into a hostile regime.
